data.one_liner: A debug overlay for Flutter to view logs, inspect HTTP requests, and trigger custom widgets in-app.
data.what_it_does: Implements a global overlay in your Flutter application for debugging purposes directly on device. It provides a log viewer, an HTTP request inspector with a JSON viewer, and supports custom global action widgets. It integrates easily via builders and works with packages like dio, http, and logger.
use_when: You need to inspect logs and HTTP requests directly on physical mobile or desktop devices without a computer.
You want a global overlay above app navigation for quick debugging actions.
avoid_when: You only require a simple console logger without in-app UI overlays.
You are shipping to production and want zero debug UI footprint (though it can be conditionally disabled).
strengths: Global overlay works above app navigation and across platforms.
Includes built-in support and middlewares for Dio, http, and dart:io clients.
Allows custom widgets for global app actions.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of buckets and integration with loggers or HTTP clients.
May consume extra device resources if not disabled in production builds.
data.setup_notes: Insert the DebugOverlay widget into your app's builder method and optionally configure log and HTTP buckets.
